title: Rommottantotto's Pack
description: Vanilla styled custom item textures and variated mobs giving your game a fresh look!
body:
- Rommottantotto's pack is just a release of my personal resource pack in case anyone would like to use it.
- It changes, thanks to [Optifine](https://optifine.net/home), item textures when having different durabilities, enchantments, names, ...
- It also has custom entity textures and many more!!

Full list of changes can be found in the pack in Rommottantotto.txt
